# Detection-only test fixture

`astronaut.png` is the scikit-image sample photograph of adult NASA astronaut Eileen Collins, used only for face localization and exact-file tests, never identity matching or indexing.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.25.2/skimage/data/astronaut.png
Documentation: https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut
NASA imagery policy/public-domain attribution: https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/

This fixture is not seeded into users' collections. No representation that the pictured person has consented to identity search is made.
